text:
Diego M: Heads up  corporate card got flagged during Airbnb checkout in Madrid so I paid the booking + cleaning fee on my personal card. Also withdrew cash and got hit with a €6 ATM fee for tips. One client dinner may be slightly over the meal cap. What's the fastest way to file?
Hannah (People Ops): Sorry about the hassle. Short checklist: attach the Airbnb confirmation/folio + the host invoice, screenshot of the card transaction showing payment, and the ATM receipt if you have it. If you lost the ATM receipt, include a short attestation and manager approval.
Diego M: I only have the bank app screenshot for the ATM withdrawal, no printed receipt. Is that OK?
Finance Ops Bot: Bank app screenshot with date, amount, and last 4 digits is acceptable for ATM fees. Set Payment Type = "Personal Card (reimburse)" for the Airbnb.
Claire S: For the client dinner over the cap  how do we request an exception?
Hannah (People Ops): For client entertainment > meal cap, attach the itemized receipt, a short business justification, and manager approval. Use "entertainment" category and note client names. Exceptions under $150 need manager sign-off; above that send to @Finance Ops for review.
Diego M: Lost receipt for the tip  small, about €10. Can I attest?
Hannah (People Ops): Yes, tips under €15 can be attested with the following template. Manager approval required.

```
Tip attestation
Employee: Diego M
Date: 2026-07-12
Vendor: Restaurante Sol
Amount: €10
Reason: Lost physical receipt; tip provided in cash to server
Manager approver: Claire S
```

Diego M: Great. Any naming convention for uploads?
Hannah (People Ops): Use: YYYYMMDD_vendor_brief_amount_currency (e.g., 20260712_Airbnb_Moreno_140EUR). Put pending items (lost receipt, ATM) in the Notes field.
Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: foreign transaction fees are reimbursable if associated with an approved business trip. Tag "expenses-foreign-fees" if you include ATM fees.
Diego M: Thanks  I'll assemble and ping @Hannah for a quick review before submitting.
